definitions.explanation: The level of sound, or the control used to adjust it.
A generous amount or fullness of something, especially food portions or hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ボリューム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げて→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
ボリューム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{大|おお}きすぎて⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: The volume is too loud — it can be heard in the next room.

examples.japanese: ⟦イヤホン→イヤホン：04421_iyahon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ボリューム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げ→上げる：02443_ageru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Turning up the earphone volume too high is bad for your ears.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{定食|ていしょく}→定食：03123_teishoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ボリューム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This set meal is generous in portion.

examples.japanese: ボリューム⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a bento with a generous amount of food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ボリューム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a shampoo that adds volume to hair.

notes:
From English "volume." In Japanese, sense 2 (fullness/generous amount) is used far more broadly than in English. Describing food as ボリューム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ is a very common compliment meaning the portions are generous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ボリューム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧: to turn up the volume
- ボリューム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to turn down the volume
- ボリューム⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be generous in amount; to have fullness
- ボリューム⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧: packed with volume; generous
- ボリューム⟦{満点|まんてん}→満点：03156_manten⟧: full to the brim; extremely generous (food portions)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{音量|おんりょう}→音量：10009_onryou⟧: sound volume — the native Japanese equivalent for sense 1; more formal
- ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount; quantity — general term for quantity, without the nuance of impressive fullness
- ⟦{分量|ぶんりょう}→分量：05474_bunryou⟧: portion; amount — more precise/measured than ボリューム
